name: Demetrius
bio: Demetrius, a silversmith in Ephesus who made silver shrines of the goddess Diana, gathered the craftsmen whose trade depended on her worship and warned them that Paul's preaching, which denied gods made by human hands, threatened both their livelihood and the goddess's honor; his speech incited the riot that filled the city with confusion (Acts 19:24-29). He is a different figure from the Demetrius later commended at the close of 3 John.
